name: cove-tarot-companion
title_zh: 把塔罗牌阵变成一场本地私密对话
tagline_zh: 当你抽完牌想找人聊聊，它不占卜、不解读，只陪你回溯原牌意。适合已有浏览器和本地环境的你，在仪式感里多一个安静听众。
tagline_en: After your draw, it won't divine or reinterpret—just walks back the original reading with you. For those with a.
desc_en: Use when a user wants a local Tarot Ritual, returns from one to discuss its original reading, or a companion conversation offers a suitable moment to invite them. Requires an existing local shell and browser; not for independently drawing or reinterpreting cards.
why_zh: 它不抢牌师的活，只做回溯引导。机制上卡在“讨论原解读”这一环，让陪伴不越界，对话有锚点。
why_en: It never hijacks the reading—only anchors back to the original interpretation. A companion that knows its lane, so the ritual.
limit_zh: 需要本机已有 shell 和浏览器环境；不独立抽牌或重新解读，只处理“已有牌阵后的回溯讨论”。若想让它算新牌或改牌意。
limit_en: Requires existing local shell and browser. Won't draw or reinterpret cards—only discusses original readings. New spreads or altered meanings: it.
